item.title: 'Roaring Night' a success
item.description: McMinnville Lions Club’s third-annual Roaring Night of Giving on Feb. 21 “went really, really well,” according to club member Kim Libonati. The 1920s-themed event raised $18,000, about 20% more than in previous years, she said. Money will be divided between the resource room for students at McMinnville High School and Lions projects such as scholarships, sight and hearing assistance and its medical device loan program. item.title: Resident pitches pollinator garden to Carlton councilors
item.description: Carlton resident Robin Geck is hoping the city will help her establish a pollinator garden in the First Street greenspace behind the old schoolhouse on Monroe Street. The proposal is to plant a diversity of native pollinators in a “welcoming space that can support community learning, seed/plant sharing and periodic community engagement,” according to a staff report. item.title: George Beryl Robertson Jr. 1943 - 2026
item.description: George Beryl Robertson Jr. wore many hats: son, brother, husband, father, journalist, editor, publisher, ombudsman, golfer, friend. item.title: Elizabeth Pratt 1950 - 2026
item.description: Elizabeth “Liz” (Limbic) Pratt, of McMinnville, Oregon, passed away February 8, 2026, at the age of 75. Elizabeth was born September 18, 1950, to Manuel and Dolores Sablan. item.title: William Dean Stohr 1938 - 2026
item.description: William Dean Stohr, 88, passed away February 27, 2026. He was born January 4, 1938, in Kansas City, Missouri. Dean proudly served his country in the United States Air Force and carried that same sense of duty and integrity throughout his life. Following his military service, he dedicated many years to working at Oregon City High School, where he became a respected and familiar presence in the community.
